title: Matrix Functions (Part 1)

tasks.description: det, inv - implement determinant and matrix inverse using backend decompositions
tasks.notes: Implemented with Bareiss algorithm for det, LU decomposition for inv

tasks.description: transpose, trace - implement matrix transpose and trace operations
tasks.notes: Supports both dense and sparse matrix formats

tasks.description: eigs, svd - expose eigendecomposition and SVD as high-level functions
tasks.notes: eigs supports both real symmetric and complex matrices

tasks.description: lu, qr - expose LU and QR decomposition as high-level functions
tasks.notes: LUP decomposition with partial pivoting, Householder QR

tasks.description: Matrix function tests - test decompositions, determinant, inverse for various matrix types

successCriteria: Determinant matches expected values for test matrices
inv(A) * A = I within numerical tolerance
SVD satisfies A = U * S * V'
LU and QR produce valid factorizations
notes: Sprint 19 matrix operations were already implemented using factory pattern. All 352 matrix tests passing.
